jobs.title: Senior Environmental Planner
jobs.description:
Description

*California location preferred; remote location considered*

**About the Role**

ICF is seeking an Environmental Planner to support environmental review and permitting for utility, infrastructure, and energy development projects throughout California.

The successful candidate will evaluate land use and environmental constraints, prepare planning and permitting documents, coordinate multidisciplinary technical reviews, and help projects advance through planning, design, and construction. This role is well suited for an organized planning professional who can manage multiple assignments, communicate effectively with clients and technical teams, and produce clear, accurate deliverables.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review project plans, site information, environmental data, technical studies, and applicable land use regulations.
* Evaluate zoning, general plan designations, specific plans, development standards, environmental constraints, and local, state, and federal permitting requirements.
* Prepare and contribute to public lands applications, environmental assessments, project descriptions, technical memoranda, permit applications, and other planning/permitting documents.
* Support environmental review and compliance under the California Environmental Quality Act and National Environmental Policy Act.
* Coordinate input from planners, engineers, GIS specialists, environmental specialists, regulatory agencies, land rights personnel, construction teams, and other project stakeholders.
* Identify missing information, permitting risks, schedule considerations, and opportunities to avoid or minimize environmental impacts.
* Communicate with clients, agencies, technical reviewers, and project teams regarding planning requirements, responsibilities, schedules, and outstanding issues.
* Maintain project trackers, schedules, action items, and deliverable status reports for multiple concurrent assignments.
* Support quality review of planning documents, permit packages, technical reports, and other client deliverables.
* Participate in client meetings and occasional travel to project sites or agency offices.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in environmental planning, geography, environmental science, natural resources, or a related field.
* 4+ years of professional experience in environmental planning, land use planning, development review, permitting, or environmental compliance.
* Experience preparing or supporting resource agency permit applications, environmental documents, technical reports, or similar planning deliverables.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of applicable local, state, or federal environmental review and permitting processes.
* Experience supporting energy, utility, infrastructure, renewable energy, or private development projects.
* Familiarity with CEQA, NEPA, and California land use and permitting processes.
* Experience preparing or coordinating discretionary and ministerial approvals with local jurisdictions.
* Experience coordinating directly with city, county, state, or federal agencies.
* Experience reviewing technical studies addressing biological resources, cultural resources, waters and wetlands, air quality, noise, transportation, hydrology, or related disciplines.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, SharePoint, Google Earth, GIS viewers, or project-tracking systems.

**Professional Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, schedules, and deadlines.
* Strong written, verbal, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability and willingness to travel to project sites or client locations as needed.
* Strong technical writing skills and the ability to translate complex planning, regulatory, and environmental information into clear documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and sound professional judgment.
* Ability to synthesize zoning, land use, environmental, and technical information into practical planning recommendations.
* Proactive follow-through and a solution-oriented approach to project challenges.
* Strong client service, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Commitment to producing high-quality work within established budgets and schedules.

**Working at ICF**

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

**Work Authorization and Sponsorship**

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

**Reasonable Accommodations**

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email Candidateaccommodation@icf.com and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.
